title: Kopytko Configuration
description: Root configuration file (.kopytkorc) for the Kopytko Framework build and tooling pipeline.

baseManifest.description: Path to the base manifest file. Required to run the application.

sourceDir.description: Root source directory relative to the workspace root. Internal @import paths are resolved relative to this directory. Should match the kopytko.imports.sourceDir VS Code setting.

archivePath.description: Path to the generated application archive. Supports template variables ${manifest.field} and ${args.env}.

generatedPackagePath.description: Path to the generated application package. Supports template variables ${manifest.field} and ${args.env}.

signedPackagePath.description: Path to a previously signed package for rekeying.

tempDir.description: Absolute path to the temporary directory used during the build process.

localManifestOverride.description: Path to a local configuration override file. Loaded last and typically git-ignored.

pluginDefinitions.description: Maps custom plugin names to their file paths.

additionalProperties.description: Absolute or relative path to the plugin implementation file.

plugins.description: Global build plugins applied on every build. Each item may be a plugin name string, an array [name, options], or an object with at least a 'name' field.

environments.description: Environment-specific configurations. Keys are environment names (e.g. "staging", "production").

manifest.description: Path to the manifest file for this environment. Optional when baseManifest is defined at the root level.

plugins.description: Plugins specific to this environment (merged with global plugins).

oneOf.description: Plugin name (NPM package name or key from pluginDefinitions).
Plugin as an object with execution-order flags.

name.description: Plugin name (NPM package name or key from pluginDefinitions).

preEnvironmentPlugin.description: When true, the plugin runs before environment plugins are applied.

postGlobalPlugin.description: When true, the plugin runs after all global plugins.
